{{Quote|Three scrumptious, thick slices of egg-dipped Iktotchian gravelwheat bread cooked golden brown and dusted with powdered Christophsian sugar. Served piping hot with bantha butter and carbosyrup.|The menu at Dex's description of the toast|<ref name="DaD" />}}
'''Iktotch toast''' was a type of [[Toast/Legends|toast]] made using thick slices of [[Egg/Legends|egg]]-dipped [[Iktotchian gravelwheat bread]] that had been cooked golden brown and powdered with [[Christophsian sugar/Legends|Christophsian sugar]]. The toast was served warm as a breakfast dish on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in the [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] known as [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], where it was prepared using a [[robo-griddle]]. [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], the diner's [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] and owner, enjoyed and served the dish, which included three slices of toast, with [[Bantha butter/Legends|bantha butter]] and [[carbosyrup]], for 4.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The price also included a breakfast side of the customer's choice, and for an additional charge of 1 credit, the toast would be served with [[ettel nut]]s or [[Zoochberry/Legends|zoochberries]]. The toast was served at Dex's<ref name="DaD" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> It shared its name with [[Iktotch/Legends|Iktotch]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iktotchon/Legends|Iktotchon]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] and home to the [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="NEGTAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Iktotch toast was mentioned in the [[2009]] [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] exclusive article, "[[Dining at Dex's]]," which was written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner.<ref name="DaD" />
